note: Every file in data/raw/ with its SHA-256. Files cut from a download that needs a login also give the SHA-256 of the full download.

vandkemi_tn.csv.xz.what: Every row with Stofparameter 'Nitrogen,total N' (ScKode 253), byte for byte, with the header, cut by tools/extract_tn.py

source.downloaded: 2026-10-01 (dataset last updated 2026-10-01 05:10 Danish time), by hand with a login

catchments/summary.csv.what: One row per candidate flow station: stated and drawn area, accepted or not

catchments/tiles.json.what: Elevation tiles used, with the request (no token) and SHA-256 of each

flow/daily.csv.xz.what: Daily mean discharge (l/s, UTC dates) per candidate station, 2010-2025, from VanDa water-flows

flow/downloads.csv.what: Size, row count and SHA-256 of every VanDa download behind daily.csv.xz

flow/coverage.csv.what: Days with flow, longest gap and validity per station-year

flow/period.json.what: The period, chosen from flow coverage only

landuse/attributes.csv.what: Per accepted catchment: farmland share, clay share, point sources, exclusion flags, district

landuse/national.json.what: National totals of the point layers (check 4) and the district list

landuse/downloads.csv.what: Every WFS response behind attributes.csv, with its SHA-256
